alex: Heads-up: PR #8342 needs merge before today's 22:00 UTC cutoff to land the kv-cache eviction hotfix. We need 2 approvals + green CI. tagging @nina @chris for eyes. release-bot will post smoke results.
release-bot: CI: queued checks for PR #8342 — unit: passed, smoke: running, e2e: pending
nina: On it, can do a quick review in ~10m. Is there a concise test plan I should follow?
alex: Test plan is in the PR description. Quick steps: start-local, run ./scripts/kv_smoke.sh against staging, verify eviction rate <2%. If smoke looks good, give approve.
chris: I'm on call (PST) but can give an LGTM if smoke passes. Quick flag: confirm migration header is present for older agents.
yoko: I can provide the second LGTM once chris approves — ping me with /approve when green.
michael: Note: if we miss cutoff we'll skip and pick into next patch window. Rollback plan: flip feature flag and revert cherry-pick; details in the ticket.
nina: Smoke run finished — logs look normal, eviction rate at ~0.8%. snippet:
```
./scripts/kv_smoke.sh --nodes 3 --rounds 5
# expect eviction_rate < 2%
```
release-bot: CI: smoke passed for PR #8342; e2e still running (estimated 8m)
chris: LGTM — verified migration header in commit c2f4a1; left 1 tiny nit but non-blocking.
yoko: LGTM — will merge once e2e is green. :thumbsup:
alex: Great — will merge after e2e completes. Cutoff is 22:00 UTC; if e2e stalls >10m escalate to @michael to decide force/hold. Thanks everyone.
release-bot: Merge executed by @alex — PR #8342 merged to release branch, deploy pipeline started.
